events.text: She sailed as MS Peter Tessel for Larvik Line from 1984.

events.quote: Between 1984 and 2008 she sailed as MS Peter Tessel for Larvik Line ( until 1996 ) and Color Line

events.text: She sailed for Larvik Line until 1996.
events.subject: self
events.quote: for Larvik Line ( until 1996 )

events.text: She sailed for Color Line from 1996.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Larvik Line ( until 1996 ) and Color Line

events.text: She sailed as MS Peter Tessel for Color Line until 2008.

events.quote: Between 1984 and 2008 she sailed as MS Peter Tessel for Larvik Line ( until 1996 ) and Color Line

events.text: The second ship was delivered on 24 June 1981 to Rederi Ab Gotland.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was delivered on 24 June 1981 to Rederi Ab Gotland

events.text: The ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna , Finland on one day following her delivery.
events.date_text: on one day following her delivery
events.subject: self
events.quote: on one day following her delivery the ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna , Finland

events.text: The ship was officially named MS Wasa Star on one day following her delivery.
events.date_text: on one day following her delivery
events.subject: self
events.quote: on one day following her delivery the ship was chartered to Vaasanlaivat / Vasabåtarna , Finland and officially named MS Wasa Star

events.text: Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa in Finland to Sundsvall in Sweden.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1981 the brand new Wasa Star started traffic on the route connecting Vaasa in Finland to Sundsvall in Sweden .

events.text: The ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In February 1982 the ship was moved to the Vaasa – Umeå route .

events.text: The ship was grounded near Holmsund.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 14 February 1981 the ship was grounded near Holmsund .

events.text: Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel, Germany and was repaired at Howaldtswerke-Deutsche Werft.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 16 February 1981 the Wasa Star continued from Helsinki to Kiel , Germany where she was finally repaired at Howaldtswerke-Deutsche Werft .

events.text: Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 April 1982 the Wasa Star returned to the Vaasa – Sundsvall route .

events.text: Wasa Star was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 31 August 1982 she was taken out of traffic and laid up in Sundsvall .

events.text: She remained in Sundsvall until May 1983.
events.subject: self
events.quote: There she remained until May 1983 , when Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line , Greece

events.text: Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line, Greece.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until May 1983 , when Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line , Greece

events.text: She left Sundsvall for Valletta, Malta where she was docked.
events.subject: self
events.quote: until May 1983 , when Vaasanlaivat sub-chartered her to Karageorgios Line , Greece and she left Sundsvall for Valletta , Malta

events.text: She started trafficking on a route connecting Patras, Greece to Ancona, Italy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In June she started trafficking on a route connecting Patras , Greece to Ancona , Italy

events.text: Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 29 August 1983 , after the various conflicting charter agreements were resolved , the Wasa Star was sold to the Norwegian operator Larvik Line .

events.text: She left Landskrona.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She left Landskrona on 13 January 1984 .

events.text: She was renamed MS Peter Wessel.
events.date_text: In March of the same year
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March of the same year she was renamed MS Peter Wessel

events.text: She started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route.
events.date_text: In March of the same year
events.subject: self
events.quote: In March of the same year she was renamed MS Peter Wessel , after Peter Wessel Tordenskiold and started operating on the Larvik–Frederikshavn route .

events.text: Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Peter Wessel collided with MS Sydfjord on 27 June 1986 .

events.text: Peter Wessel was extended at Blohm + Voss, Hamburg, Germany and additional cabins were built on the top of the ship.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Peter Wessel was extended by meters at Blohm + Voss , Hamburg , Germany in 1988 . Additional cabins were also built on the top of the ship .

events.text: Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In October 1996 Color Line chartered the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line

events.text: Parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins, decreasing her car capacity.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1999 parts of the cardeck were built in with cabins , decreasing her car capacity .

events.text: The ship was rebuilt again at Remontowa, Poland with large side sponsons.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In spring 2003 the ship was rebuilt again , this time at Remontowa , Poland with large side sponsons

events.text: Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2004 Color Line bought the Peter Wessel from Larvik Line .

events.text: The ship was transferred to the Larvik—Hirtshals route.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In April 2006 the ship was transferred to the Larvik—Hirtshals route .

events.text: A fire broke out in one of the ships electric switchboards, which forced her to sail to Frederikshavn.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 22 March 2007 a fire broke out in one of the ships electric switchboards , which forced her to sail to Frederikshavn .

events.text: The ship returned to service on 26 April 2007.
events.subject: self
events.quote: returning to service on 26 April 2007 .

events.text: Color Line reported that the Peter Wessel has been sold to Mediterranean Shipping Company.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 October 2007 Color Line reported that the Peter Wessel has been sold to Mediterranean Shipping Company

events.text: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The Peter Wessel was delivered to her new owners on 16 April 2008

events.text: The Peter Wessel was subsequently renamed MS SNAV Toscana.
events.subject: self
events.quote: subsequently renamed MS SNAV Toscana

events.text: The SNAV Toscana left Norway for the Mediterranean.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 19 April 2008 the SNAV Toscana left Norway for the Mediterranean

events.text: She entered service on SNAVs Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service.
events.subject: self
events.object: SNAVs Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service
events.quote: She entered service on SNAVs Civitavecchia—Palermo or Civitavecchia – Olbia service during 2008

events.text: SNAV Toscana was renamed as GNV Azzurra.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 2017 , SNAV Toscana was renamed as GNV Azzurra .
